summary: Police arrest one suspect after a week of broken car windows and say more charges may come.
realLife: After a week of dozens of cars with windows shot out overnight, police used witness accounts and scene evidence to find a vehicle, spotted it on patrol, stopped the driver, found a BB gun, charged him with twelve counts of destroying property and said more were expected.
